ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; dominant low-intensity (black) pixels across >95% of the visible surface with high-intensity (white) limited to distal edges and discrete barnacle sites.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity block covering approximately 90% of the surface area; high-contrast focal spots (white/light-grey) are scattered non-uniformly across both lobes; thin high-intensity linear banding observed on the distal margins of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees; notch depth is moderate relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations; trailing edge displays a series of irregular sharp peaks and deep valleys (indentations), particularly pronounced on the distal half of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Right lobe shows an upward concave sweep transitioning into a complex, jagged terminal tip; left lobe exhibits a more uniform concave-upward trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast circular pixel clusters (diameters ranging from 3-10 pixels) distributed across the central and outer regions of both lobes, consistent with barnacle attachment points.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue irregularity and jagged material loss along the trailing edge of the right lobe; dense barnacle colonization clusters visible on the lateral tips and leading edges.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced fringe-like biological growth or debris extending 5-15 pixels beyond the physical boundary of the lateral tips.
